title: Artificial intelligence is creating a new global linguistic hierarchy

bias_targets.methodology: Longitudinal analysis of AI resources (models and datasets on Hugging Face) across 6,003 languages to measure the hyper-concentration and power-law (Zipfian) distribution of language technologies among a few dominant languages.

Mapping language geographical centroids and comparing model availability against speaker populations to identify systemic regional underrepresentation, particularly contrasting highly resourced European languages with under-resourced languages in Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, and the Middle East.

Using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and hierarchical linear mixed-effects regression to evaluate the relationship between the number of available AI models and subnational socioeconomic indicators (e.g., Human Development Index, GDP per capita, educational attainment) alongside digital infrastructure metrics.
